text: Ɓe wi'anoyta Ñande Ummital : "Gomɗii on ardirii Men hannde gooto-gooto, on heddoraa jawdi e laamu -wano Men Fuɗɗorinoo on ka arannde laawol ko on holuɓe ɗi fow. On accii kon ko Men Jeynunoo on aduna. Men Yiidaali e mon kadi non hannde, reweteeɗi mon ɗi aaƴotonoɗon wonnde ko ɗi kafiduɓe e Alla ka hanndugol e dewal. Gomɗii tawƴondiral waɗii hakkunde mo'on : kadi kon ko aaƴotonoɗon e tefaneede maa wonnde ko ɗi kafiduɗi e Alla fow majjitorii on.
